text: I feel a quiet curiosity stirring within me, surrounded by the clean lines and cool reflections of glass and technology. The world here is one of inquiry and creativity—a space devoted to the pursuit of knowledge and the promise of innovation. The acronym "R+D" on the wall reminds me that the boundary between what is known and unknown is being consciously explored. I feel at once small and invigorated, as if I am on the cusp of discovery in a place where ideas are nurtured and developed.
